# s38584 mathematical state-function contract

This appendix defines a two-state mathematical state machine. Abstract state q0..q1425 has unspecified initial values. There is no reset input. GND=0 and VDD=1. Inputs and state map to mathematical variables in the following table.

F0=0 and F1=1. Leaf variables precede acyclic truth functions. Each row lists arguments from the least significant to the most significant address bit. The function value is the addressed bit of the truth-table integer. This executable mathematical definition requires no inferred application meaning.
